name: enterprise-clean-room
description: IP boundary + never-push wall for working beside an employer codebase: denies tripwire content and enterprise-remote git traffic; marks the repo ip_class enterprise.

params.name: tripwire_regex
params.prompt: Employer-identifying strings as a regex alternation (e.g. AcmeCorp|acme\.internal)

params.name: forbidden_remote_regex
params.prompt: Enterprise git remote host pattern (e.g. github\.acme\.example)

bash.name: pack-no-enterprise-remote
bash.reason: enterprise-clean-room pack: git traffic to an enterprise remote from this workspace is a hard boundary.

bash.name: pack-no-gh-to-enterprise-host
bash.reason: enterprise-clean-room pack: gh invocation naming the enterprise host. gh reaches the remote through the GitHub API, so git-push rules never see it - this boundary is the same one.

bash.name: pack-no-gh-write-ops
bash.reason: enterprise-clean-room pack: gh write operation from a clean-room workspace. gh targets the current checkout's remote - enterprise here - even when no host appears in the command; read-only gh (view/list/checks/status) stays allowed.

bash.name: pack-no-tripwire-in-commands
bash.reason: enterprise-clean-room pack: employer tripwire string in a command. Keep employer content out of this workspace.

write.name: pack-no-tripwire-content
write.reason: enterprise-clean-room pack: employer tripwire string crossing into written content.
